description: This file defines the UnsafeRowWriter class, a helper for writing data into a global row buffer in UnsafeRow format within Apache Spark's SQL Catalyst module. It manages null bits, fixed-size data, and variable-length data for rows.

classes.name: UnsafeRowWriter
classes.description: A final class that extends UnsafeWriter, providing methods to write various data types into an UnsafeRow buffer, manage null bits, and handle variable-length data for Spark SQL.

methods.name: UnsafeRowWriter
methods.description: Constructors for initializing UnsafeRowWriter with different parameters such as number of fields, buffer size, or existing UnsafeWriter and UnsafeRow instances.

methods.name: getRow
methods.description: Sets the total size of the UnsafeRow and returns the UnsafeRow object.

methods.name: resetRowWriter
methods.description: Resets the starting offset, grows buffer if needed, and clears null bits before writing a new nested struct.

methods.name: zeroOutNullBytes
methods.description: Clears null bits in the buffer by zeroing out the relevant bytes.

methods.name: isNullAt
methods.description: Checks if the field at the given ordinal is null.

methods.name: setNullAt
methods.description: Sets the null bit for the specified field and writes zero.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Overloaded methods to write boolean, byte, short, int, long, float, double, and Decimal values into the buffer at the specified ordinal.

methods.name: getFieldOffset
methods.description: Calculates the memory offset for a field based on its ordinal.
